delegate().details: When PD is enabled, only the PD contract can call this.      When PD is disabled, anyone can call this.      No nonReentrant — called back by PD during handleRedelegation flow.

params._to: Search end index (0 or >= requestCount means search till end).

handleRedelegation(address).details: Validates the caller is a factory-deployed CnStaking contract.      Stakes KAIA on behalf of the user via PD's stakeFor().

params._user: The user receiving the redelegated stake.

initialize(address).details: Called once by the factory after deploying the BeaconProxy.

params._owner: The owner of this CnStaking (can be an EOA or multisig).

initializeWithPD(address,address).details: Called once by the factory after deploying both CnStaking and PD beacon proxies.      Verifies the PD's baseCnStaking points back to this contract.

params._owner: The owner of this CnStaking (can be an EOA or multisig).
params._publicDelegation: The PublicDelegation proxy address (already deployed by factory).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

redelegate(address,address,uint256).details: Only callable by the PD contract. Redelegation is always enabled when PD exists.      Anti-hopping: user cannot redelegate again within STAKE_LOCKUP of their last redelegation.

params._user: The user initiating the redelegation (managed by PD).
params._value: The amount of KAIA to redelegate.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdrawApprovedStaking(uint256).details: If STAKE_LOCKUP has passed: execute the withdrawal.      If 2*STAKE_LOCKUP has passed: auto-cancel the withdrawal.

approveStakingWithdrawal(address,uint256.notice: Schedule a withdrawal of delegated stakes.

getApprovedStakingWithdrawalIds(uint256,.notice: Query withdrawal request IDs matching a given state.

handleRedelegation(address).notice: Handle incoming re-delegation from another CnStaking contract.

initialize(address).notice: Initialize the CnStaking contract without PublicDelegation.

initializeWithPD(address,address).notice: Initialize the CnStaking contract with PublicDelegation.

publicDelegation().notice: The PublicDelegation contract address (address(0) if PD disabled).

redelegate(address,address,uint256).notice: Redelegate stakes to another CnStaking contract.

staking().notice: Total delegated stake held by this contract.

unstaking().notice: Total amount pending in approved withdrawal requests.

withdrawApprovedStaking(uint256).notice: Execute or auto-cancel an approved withdrawal.
